Files shaped like CourtReserve's and Playbypoint's exports, for move_files.test.ts. Neither system publishes its export
columns: these use the names each one documents (sources in packages/core/src/move_read.ts), and the messy ones what a
real export may add (a title line, odd spacing and case, accents, Excel's date numbers, a negative "unsubscribe" column).
Every person and address here is made up (example.test).
